flash.addedLocal: Added {{name}}, with its value on this computer.
flash.addedPortal: Added {{name}}, with its value on this computer. Set its published value in the Fabric portal.
flash.addedToo: Added {{name}}, with its value on this computer. Set its published value too.
flash.savedLocal: Saved the value of {{name}} on this computer.

errors.publishedRead: Couldn’t read your published app’s secrets.
errors.localCheck: Couldn’t check the values on this computer. {{message}}

confirm.removeDeclared: Remove the value of {{name}} from this computer? Functions that read it fail when your app runs here, until you set it again.
confirm.removeUnused: Remove the value of {{name}} from this computer? rayfin.yml doesn’t list it, so your app doesn’t use it.
confirm.deleteMessage: Delete {{name}} from your published app and from rayfin.yml? Functions that read it stop working until you add it again. You can’t undo this.

details.label: {{name}} details
details.useHint: Read it only inside a Rayfin function. Code in the browser can’t see secrets, and shouldn’t.
details.noValueTeam: This app has no value for this secret, so functions that read it fail. Set one in the Fabric portal.
details.undeclaredTeam: rayfin.yml doesn’t list this secret, so functions can’t read it by name yet. Ask Copilot to add it.
details.hidden: Hidden. Nobody can read a value back, not even you. To change it, set a new one.
details.undeclaredStored: rayfin.yml doesn’t list this secret, so functions can’t read it by name. Set its published value again to add it.
details.undeclaredLocal: rayfin.yml doesn’t list this secret, so functions can’t read it by name. Remove its value if you don’t need it.
details.localMissing: Functions that read it fail when your app runs on this computer. Set a value to fix that.
details.localSaved: Saved in your project’s .rayfin-local folder, outside your code and History.
details.localSavedDeclared: Saved in your project’s .rayfin-local folder, outside your code and History. To change it, set a new one.
details.localEnv: Your app uses the {{name}} environment variable Fabricator started with. To change it, change the variable and restart Fabricator.
details.localSettings: Read from local.settings.json in your functions folder. A value you set here is used instead.
details.publishLater: Values for the published app can be set after you publish it.
details.publishedFailed: Fabricator couldn’t read your published app’s values.
details.publishedMissing: Your published app has no value for this secret, so its functions that read it fail. Set one to fix that.

overview.label: About secrets
overview.step1: Add a secret with a name and a value. The value stays on this computer, outside your code and History.
overview.step2: Your app’s functions read it by name, such as {{expression}}.
overview.stepTeam: The published app and your preview keep their own values: change them in the Fabric portal. Nobody can read a value back.
overview.stepPublished: Your published app keeps its own values. Nobody can read one back: to change it, set a new one.
overview.noFunctions: This app doesn’t use functions yet, and only functions can read secrets. Ask Copilot to add a function when you need one. Functions aren’t available in every Fabric region or tenant.
